title: P2: CoAP proxy overly broad exception handling
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/proxy.py (lines 99-100)

All exceptions are caught and converted to BAD_GATEWAY (5.02), but some exceptions indicate client errors:
- UnresolvableAddress from aiocoap for malformed URIs should be BAD_REQUEST (4.00)
- Timeout errors could be GATEWAY_TIMEOUT (5.04) for better diagnostics

Impact: Incorrect status codes returned; harder to debug client issues.

Fix: Catch specific exception types and return appropriate CoAP status codes.
